Nehemiah wept, mourned, fasted and prayed when he heard of Jerusalem. What breaks your heart?
Nehemiah's prayer starts with worship and confession. How does his prayer shape yours?
Nehemiah prayed silently before answering the king. How can you pray in the moment?
"The good hand of my God was upon me." How has God's good hand been on you?
Nehemiah said, "The God of heaven will make us prosper." How do you respond to opposition?
Everyone worked on the section of wall near them. Where is your section of the wall?
Some nobles would not stoop to serve. How can pride keep us from serving?
The people built because they had a mind to work. What helps you keep working when mocked?
They prayed and set a guard. How do prayer and practical action go together?
"Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers." Who can you stand with?
Nehemiah was angry that the poor were being exploited. How can you stand up for the poor?
"Ought you not to walk in the fear of our God?" How does fearing God shape how we treat others?
Nehemiah did not take what was his right because of the fear of God. What rights could you set aside?
Nehemiah said, "I am doing a great work and I cannot come down." What distractions pull you from God's work?
Nehemiah prayed, "Now, O God, strengthen my hands." Where do you need strength?
The wall was finished, and the enemies knew it was done with the help of God. How does God show his help?
Nehemiah appointed a faithful man who feared God more than many. What makes someone trustworthy?
"My God put it into my heart." What has God put into your heart?
Ezra read the law and the people listened attentively. How do you listen to God's word?
They read clearly and gave the sense so people understood. Who helps you understand the Bible?
"The joy of the Lord is your strength." Where do you need his joy and strength?
The Levites praised God as Creator and promise-keeper. Which of these do you praise him for?
Even when they were stubborn, God did not forsake them. How has God been patient with you?
"You are a gracious and merciful God." How have you experienced his grace?
The people joined in a curse and an oath to walk in God's law. How seriously do you take your commitment to God?
"We will not neglect the house of our God." How can you care for God's house and people?
The people blessed those who willingly offered to live in Jerusalem. How can you willingly serve where needed?
Ordinary families are named as they settle the city. What does it mean that God notices those who quietly serve?
They dedicated the wall with gladness, thanksgiving and singing. How can you celebrate God's work?
"The joy of Jerusalem was heard far away." How can your joy in God be heard by others?
Nehemiah restored support for the Levites and singers. How can you support those who serve?
Nehemiah restored the Sabbath. What does keeping a day for God look like for you?
Nehemiah prayed, "Remember me, O my God, for good." What would you like God to remember about your life?
